tool_input.command: pwd && ls -la /work/requests && echo "---" && ls /out 2>/dev/null; echo "---schema---"; find / -iname "lu-manifest.schema.json" 2>/dev/null
git log -1 --format='%H %an %s' && git remote -v && cat pyproject.toml | head -20

for f in src/requests/*.py; do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  grep -nE 'import requests|import httpx|urllib\.request|socket\.socket|fetch\(|axios\.|net/http|reqwest::|HttpClient' "$f"
  grep -nE 'open\(|os\.path|pathlib|fs\.|std::fs|ioutil|java\.io\.File' "$f"
  grep -nE 'subprocess|child_process|os/exec|std::process|ProcessBuilder' "$f"
  grep -nE 'os\.environ|process\.env|os\.Getenv|std::env|System\.getenv' "$f"
  grep -nE 'time\.time|Date\.now|time\.Now|Instant::now|currentTimeMillis' "$f"
  grep -nE 'random\.|Math\.random|rand\.|rand::' "$f"
done 2>&1
